Every observed input and rank seal must be after formation close and before execution-session open; no future rows, missing required fields, incomplete pages or silent rebasing. Input eligibility is not authorization to execute.
revisions: New forward calculation requires a coherent full-window adjusted-price snapshot; do not splice current adjustments into old source prices. Original archived cohort and raw/adjusted capture semantics retained.
current_time: Before formation close, keep BLOCKED without price requests or new rankings. Missed deadline is SKIP_CYCLE/INCOMPLETE, never shifted forward.
publication: Only aggregate counts, hashes, source URLs and blockers public; all per-symbol raw responses, mapping evidence and prices private work/.
restrictions: All prior tracked files and 156 core files unchanged; no paid data, stock price probe, scheduler, account mutation or orders in current run.
